dataset.description: Attack-emulation ground-truth corpus (AI-E1.8): Wazuh 4.14 alerts generated for Atomic Red Team tests and Caldera-style campaigns, mixed with benign noise and benign look-alikes. Labels come from the procedure that produced each alert. Generated by tests/fixtures/attack_corpus; see docs/evaluation.md.

notes: The dataset is synthetic: hand-written or generated alerts with labels assigned by construction. It exercises the pipeline; it says nothing about accuracy on real customer telemetry.
Runs that stopped for analyst review or action approval were recorded as 'unreviewed': the harness never supplies an analyst decision.
